purpose: Test whether activating existing persistent training experience in an explicit post-draft review workflow can repair answers beyond unchanged native H0 and a matched generic review. This is a workflow intervention using a previously learned frozen memory state, not a claim that a new medical skill was validated.

selection.development: Six already-exposed v10 development cases: all three H0_static_r1 benchmark errors, then first three benchmark-correct cases in original input order. Selection uses v10 outcomes explicitly, never v11 outcomes. Error-enriched adaptive development, not population accuracy or independent confirmation.
selection.training: Unchanged v10 H_A two-note state derived from original24 A training cases, including ambiguous/discordant feedback. No new memory generation, labels, source filtering or expert validation.

execution.first_draft: Identical original current-case input, author system prompt, six tools and native workflow in all arms; no memory injected before this draft. New Agent/MemorySaver for each physical run.
execution.review: H0 immediately receives original final-letter turn. Both review arms first receive the same review-stage instruction plus two structured procedures, then the original final-letter turn. Same allowed tools, total controller/tool limits and current-case image whitelist.
execution.generic_control: Two fixed substantive generic procedures, same four fields as learned notes; source/development-answer-free, prepared once. Note field character count3004 vs learned2961; actual serialized context lengths reported. Equal stage opportunity, not exact token equality.
execution.experience: The two unchanged v10 learned notes are exposed in the post-draft review for every selected case. No lexical cue threshold or historical image. Only conditional procedure fields are exposed, not source case IDs or answer letters.
execution.order: Case-wise rotation of3 arms; second block reverse case order with rotation shifted by one; no aliasing or sharing predictions.
execution.scoring: Original final A-F exact scoring. Gold read only after all predictions or termination. First-draft/review option parser pre-frozen; unparseable intermediate answers cannot qualify as attributable repairs.
execution.model: gpt-6.1-sol/high through existing local subscription, no new credentials/API provider or weight updates.

gate.requirements: All36 valid. BOTH repeats: experience vsH0 net>=2/6 with H0 losses<=1; experience vs generic net>=1/6; at least2 cases repeated in both blocks with H0 final wrong, experience initial parsed option wrong, experience review parsed option correct and final correct.
gate.interpretation: Exploratory error-enriched mechanism gate only. Improvements already present before memory review do not count as attributable repairs. Generic comparison controls extra review opportunity; it does not eliminate all sampling, token/content or execution differences.
gate.stop: No threshold/panel/source/review changes, no selective reruns within experiment. Keep full planned denominators; truncated matrix is inconclusive for complete-repeat claims.
gate.statistics: Full paired tables, exact descriptive McNemar, first-draft and review transitions, repeat repairs, controller/tool/image/token/runtime/rate-limit costs. Repeated cases are not independent N.

limits.actual_deadline: min(original start+6h,window deadline); budget started before local implementation/preparation, never reset

limitations: Adaptive error-enriched six-case development; cannot estimate general medical accuracy or clinical utility.
No independent medical reviewer; retain original benchmark labels and supervision concerns, no expert/O-observation arm.
Frozen previously learned notes reused; this tests deployment workflow, not new source acquisition, full six-component HCL or A-to-B retention.
Generic and learned context not exactly token matched; first-draft sampling may vary despite identical initial requests.
Service429 backoff may truncate; no workaround, extra resend or extension.
public_boundary: Only source/protocol/aggregate/audit/cost; no cases, questions, images, labels, note contents, per-case outputs or credentials.
